data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable slider with vertical or horizontal orientation, color, size, and callbacks for value changes and completion.
use_when: Need an iOS‑style slider in a Flutter app
Need a slider that supports both vertical and horizontal layouts
Need callbacks for continuous and finished value changes
avoid_when: Need advanced state management or theming integration beyond basic colors
weaknesses: No built‑in theming or advanced customization
data.minimal_example:
FillingSlider(
  direction: FillingSliderDirection.horizontal,
  initialValue: 0.5,
  color: Colors.blue,
  onChange: (value) => print(value),
  onFinish: (value) => print('finished: $value'),
)
